description: Compute the same facts with and without Small Business Relief (revenue ≤ AED 3m, periods ending by 31 Dec 2029). Shows tax payable and what carries forward each way: in an SBR year a tax loss and disallowed interest are forfeited. Takes the same inputs as grotax_compute_ct (sbrElect is ignored).

accountingProfit.description: Net profit (or loss, negative) per the financial statements, AED

associateShare.description: Equity-accounted share of profit (+) or loss (-) of associates and joint ventures, AED (taken out)

connectedExcess.description: Payments to connected persons above market value, AED

connectedPayments.description: Total paid to connected persons in the period, AED (raises the transfer pricing disclosure warning above AED 500,000)

depreciation.description: Depreciation and amortisation, AED (used to calculate tax-EBITDA when ebitda is not given)

dividendsExpensed.description: Dividends or profit distributions booked as expenses, AED (always added back)

ebitda.description: Tax-EBITDA, AED, for the 30% interest cap. Leave out to have it calculated from taxable income + net interest + depreciation

entertainment.description: Total client entertainment expense, AED (50% is added back)

exemptDividends.description: Exempt dividends from UAE/free zone companies, AED

exemptIncomeExpenses.description: Expenses relating to exempt income, AED

foreignTaxExpensed.description: Foreign and withholding taxes booked as expenses, AED (added back)

interestBF.description: Net interest disallowed in earlier periods and carried forward, AED (deducted within this period's cap)

mne.description: Member of a multinational group (blocks SBR)

naturalPerson.description: The business is owned by an individual (sole establishment or civil company of a natural person)

ownerDrawings.description: Owner's drawings or salary booked as expenses, AED (added back only when naturalPerson is true)

qfzp.description: Treat as a Qualifying Free Zone Person (simplified: 0% on qualifying income)

qualifyingIncome.description: QFZP qualifying income taxed at 0%, AED

realisationElect.description: Elected to tax gains and losses on realisation rather than as booked

revenue.description: Revenue for the tax period, AED (drives Small Business Relief and audit checks)

revenueExceededBefore.description: Revenue exceeded AED 3m in an earlier CT period (blocks SBR permanently)

sbrElect.description: Elect Small Business Relief if eligible

unrealisedGains.description: Net unrealised gain (+) or loss (-) in the accounts, AED (adjusted only when realisationElect is true)

name: grotax_compare_sbr
title: groTAX: Small Business Relief, elected vs not
